title: Clamping Press
pages: Craft the controller with sticky pistons, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put an iron block directly beneath it and a smithing table directly above it. Face sticky pistons inward on its east and west sides only; the north and south sides stay open. Place iron bars at all four lower diagonal corners around the iron base as support feet.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded clamping recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing support foot, iron base, smithing table lid, or outward/missing side piston stops operation. The four iron bars must remain in loaded chunks.

It runs 20 exclusive datapack clamping recipes, each shown in JEI with its required batch size. Four slime balls clamp into a pressure gasket for the Leaching Vat. Seventeen rows clamp tagged mod ingots (any forge:ingots entry, so other mods' matching metals work) into vanilla metal goods: aluminum into rails, chromium into powered rails, lead into detector rails, silver into activator rails, nickel into a compass, tin into shears, vanadium into a blast furnace, zinc into a spyglass, cobalt into a piston, iridium into a sticky piston, manganese into a crossbow, titanium into soul lanterns, palladium into a golden apple, rhodium into a golden carrot and ruthenium into a glistering melon slice. Six niobium ingots clamp into a bell and seven thallium ingots into iron horse armor, neither of which has a crafting recipe. Each costs at least the vanilla metal it replaces, and nothing turns the product back into a mod ingot. Nine ice press into one packed ice and nine packed ice press further into one blue ice, the same ratios the Phase Modulator and Capacitor Array return, so ice cannot be multiplied by cycling. Hand-feeding: right-click a formed controller with the input to load it into the stock buffer; each batch then takes 40 ticks, and an empty-hand right-click collects the product. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.

Pressure gaskets seal the Resonance Basin's water cross: two of them replace the middle-row amethyst shards either side of the stonecutter, with sealed steel plates in the corners and amethyst shards above and below. Keep the Clamping Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser needs the Basin's harmonic lens. A bare amethyst shard does not substitute for a gasket.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
